title: TART: A Modular Tool for Technique-Aware Audio-to-Tablature Guitar Transcription
abstract: arXiv:2609.11904v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automatic Music Transcription (AMT) for guitar remains limited by three challenges: existing systems often fail to capture expressive techniques such as slides, bends, and percussive hits; they often assign notes to incorrect string-fret combinations; and they are typically trained on clean recordings, limiting their generalization to noisy real-world audio. To address these challenges, we propose TART, a modular four-stage audio-to-tablature pipeline consisting of (1) an audio-to-MIDI transcription model, (2) an expressive technique classifier, (3) an audio-conditioned T5 encoder-decoder for string-fret assignment, and (4) an automated tablature generator. We evaluate TART in a zero-shot setting on GuitarSet, EGDB, and two augmented benchmarks, Noisy GuitarSet and Noisy EGDB. translated_title: TART：一个模块化的、可识别演奏技巧的音频转吉他六线谱转录工具
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.11904v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：针对吉他的自动音乐转录（AMT）仍然受限于三个挑战：现有系统往往无法捕捉滑音、弯音和打击音等表现性演奏技巧；它们常常将音符分配到错误的弦-品组合；而且它们通常在干净录音上训练，这限制了它们对嘈杂真实世界音频的泛化能力。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了TART，一个模块化的四阶段音频转六线谱流水线，包括：（1）音频转MIDI的转录模型，（2）表现性技巧分类器，（3）用于弦-品分配的音频条件化T5编码器-解码器，以及（4）自动化六线谱生成器。我们在零样本设置下在GuitarSet、EGDB以及两个增强基准Noisy GuitarSet和Noisy EGDB上对TART进行了评估。在这四个基准上的平均结果显示，TART达到了81.35%的音频转MIDI F50（比之前的最佳基线高6.67个百分点），以及71.8%的弦-品Tab F1（高8.5个百分点）（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出TART，一个模块化四阶段流水线，能够识别滑音、弯音等吉他演奏技巧并准确进行弦-品分配，且对嘈杂真实音频具有泛化能力，在多个基准上零样本超越了现有最佳方法。
en_tdlr: TART, a modular four-stage pipeline, enables technique-aware guitar transcription with accurate string-fret assignment and robustness to noisy real-world audio, outperforming prior baselines in zero-shot evaluation across multiple benchmarks.
